name: Few-shot regulatory sequence design with a genomic language model
description: Inference-time procedure that prompts the Evo 2 genomic language model with tens of example regulatory DNA sequences of one class to generate novel sequences of that class without additional training, with optional reinforcement learning using sequence-to-function models as rewards.
